# Drift and rounding of forms A, B, C, generated by drift.py

Seed 20261110, steps 'small'. N = 1 is one correctly rounded unit motor; N > 1 a chain of N correctly rounded unit motors composed in the scalar with the library's compose (bit for bit, replay.txt). Each motor moves one point, one line, and one plane. Forms C-pre and C-post give the same bits, so C stands for both.
